title: 🌙 Add Dark Mode
content: Create elegant dark mode using Tailwind dark: prefix. Background: bg-gray-900 for main, bg-gray-800 for cards. Text: text-gray-100 for primary, text-gray-400 for secondary. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio minimum. Use muted accent colors - slightly desaturated. Add dark:border-gray-700 for borders. Include theme toggle button with Sun/Moon icons. Store preference in localStorage. Support system preference detection with prefers-color-scheme. Add smooth transition-colors for theme switching.

variants.simple: Add dark mode with theme toggle and proper dark color scheme.
variants.detailed: Create elegant dark mode using Tailwind dark: prefix. Background: bg-gray-900 for main, bg-gray-800 for cards. Text: text-gray-100 for primary, text-gray-400 for secondary. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio minimum. Use muted accent colors - slightly desaturated. Add dark:border-gray-700 for borders. Include theme toggle button with Sun/Moon icons. Store preference in localStorage. Support system preference detection with prefers-color-scheme. Add smooth transition-colors for theme switching.
variants.advanced: Create elegant dark mode with comprehensive theming system. Color mapping: bg-white -> dark:bg-gray-900 (base), bg-gray-50 -> dark:bg-gray-800 (cards), bg-gray-100 -> dark:bg-gray-700 (hover states). Text: text-gray-900 -> dark:text-gray-100 (primary), text-gray-600 -> dark:text-gray-400 (secondary), text-gray-400 -> dark:text-gray-500 (muted). Borders: border-gray-200 -> dark:border-gray-700. Shadows: add dark:shadow-gray-900/50 for depth in dark mode. Accent colors: slightly desaturate - blue-600 -> dark:blue-500, use opacity variants. Theme toggle component: button with Sun/Moon icons from lucide-react, animate rotation on switch. State management: useState with useEffect for localStorage sync. System preference: useMediaQuery for prefers-color-scheme, default to system. HTML class strategy: add "dark" class to html element. Transitions: transition-colors duration-200 on body for smooth switch. Ensure images work in dark mode - add dark:brightness-90 if needed. Form inputs: dark:bg-gray-800 dark:border-gray-600. Code blocks: use dark theme syntax highlighting.
